# The remaining entries fall into a handful of principled buckets
# that need infrastructure beyond what the expression engine
# itself provides:
#
#  * `projection/*` (interpolate/step) need a `projectionDefinition`
#    value type for the projection-transition shape.
#  * `legacy/identity/{color,number}_array` and the matching
#    `interpolate*/linear-color-array` fixtures need `colorArray`
#    and `numberArray` first-class value types (the `{values:[…]}`
#    JSON shape upstream emits).
#  * `legacy/identity/padding` needs a `padding` value type.
#  * `collator/*` needs ICU-aware string comparison for the
#    diacritic-insensitive `ü` ≡ `u` rule.
#  * `id/basic` needs `Feature.id` to admit string ids — the
#    current `Option<u64>` only carries integers.
#  * `constant-folding/*` and `get/from-literal--missing` need
#    parse-time constant folding so eval errors on fully-constant
#    subtrees surface as compile errors.
#  * `coalesce/error` flips the error-swallow contract on coalesce
#    in the opposite direction from `legacy/{exponential,
#    interval}/*-default`; honoring it would break the legacy
#    converter without a separate "strict" coalesce variant.

# Coalesce error-mode mismatch — see header. Honoring this would
# regress the legacy-function-driven defaults.

# diacritic-/case-insensitive equality these fixtures pin.

# object properties) surface as compile-time errors.
